paper.title: Experimental and finite element dynamic analysis of incrementally loaded reinforced concrete structures
paper.version: Published version of record, 13 pages; printed pages 15-27. User supplied; no accepted-manuscript licence claimed.

measurement.frequency: Five hammer impacts at quarter-span points; averaged Fourier spectra of 8 second free-decay acceleration records; 1652 Hz sampling; measured unloaded after approximately 30 minute peak-load hold.
measurement.vibration_amplitude: Described as low amplitude; no numerical displacement amplitude provided.
measurement.static: Micrometer at peak load and after unloading.
measurement.reported_deflection_limit: span/250 target; Fig. 11 final Beam 3 peak exceeds this target.

supports.value: Simply supported, one fixed bearing and one low-friction bearing

load_arrangement.value: Symmetric three-point bending, point load at midspan

overhang_each_m.reason: Symmetric supports assumed from stated symmetric test and Fig. 3; not independently dimensioned.

effective_depth_mm.reason: 120 - 25 - 10/2; assumes cover denotes clear cover to main bars. Appendix B uses bar centre 20 mm above soffit, inconsistent with Table 2, so this is not adopted for blind modelling.

reinforcement.bar_depth_discrepancy: Table 2 implies 30 mm bar centre above soffit; Appendix B node y=-40 in 120 mm deep section implies 20 mm.

yield_load_kN.reason: Paper formula Py = 4 My / span with My approximately 3.00 kNm; used only for supplemental comparison.

missing: Static peak and residual deflections for Beams 1, 2, 4 and 5 are not published in this PDF.
Raw Beam 3 load-deflection records are needed to check vector-assisted graph readings and quantify measurement uncertainty.
Measured cracking loads and pre-test static baseline stiffness are absent for all five beams.
Beam-specific test ages, density, damping and quantitative vibration amplitude are absent.
Independent concrete tensile tests, measured steel elastic modulus and ultimate strain are absent; Table 2 and Appendix B disagree on bar depth.
Beam 3 may have pre-existing damage (p. 21); its undamaged static reference cannot be reconstructed from the published measurements.
